title: Tavi the Little Lantern Boat and the Moonlit River
description: A teal lantern boat and his lavender friend float a quiet Moonlight Lantern Festival down a sleepy river, then rest beside their cozy boathouse under the moon.

Tavi.role: Main character; a little lantern boat
Tavi.color: Soft teal-blue hull with a cream upper rim, pale aqua deck, and one small cream curved canopy
Tavi.bodyShape: Small rounded wooden riverboat with a broad bow and compact body; no arms, hands, legs, or clothing
Tavi.face: Two large warm dark-brown eyes on the front upper bow above a tiny curved smile
Tavi.accessories: Exactly one small golden lantern on a short post near the rear deck

Dottie.role: Supporting character; a little lavender riverboat
Dottie.color: Soft pastel lavender hull with a warm ivory upper rim, light lilac deck, and a small rounded ivory cabin
Dottie.bodyShape: Slightly shorter and narrower than Tavi; smooth oval hull with a rounded bow; no arms, hands, legs, or clothing
Dottie.face: Two friendly dark-brown eyes on the front upper bow and a small warm smile
Dottie.accessories: Exactly one small golden lantern on a short post beside the rear cabin

settingBible.Moonlit River: A peaceful storybook river with willow trees, reeds, an old wooden footbridge, golden lantern reflections, distant cottage lights, and a cozy wooden boathouse
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded toy-like boats, golden evening fading to moonlight, one scene per page, and no readable text

continuityRules: Tavi stays teal-blue with a cream canopy, bow eyes, and exactly one rear golden lantern.
Dottie stays lavender with an ivory cabin, bow eyes, and first appears on page 4.
Dottie remains visibly smaller than Tavi.
Background festival boats stay secondary and may appear only on early festival and mid-parade pages.
Pages 14–15 show Tavi and Dottie resting and sleeping beside the boathouse, not inside it.
No rescue, repair, danger, or frightening scenes.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, text, badge, logo, or readable words.

pages.text: Along a peaceful little river, a cheerful teal-blue boat named Tavi loved floating past the quiet gardens and willow trees.
pages.illustrationScene: Teal-blue lantern boat Tavi floats along a peaceful river past quiet gardens and willow trees.
pages.continuityNotes: Lock Tavi: soft teal-blue hull, cream canopy, pale aqua deck, dark-brown bow eyes, one rear golden lantern. Dottie absent.

pages.text: One golden evening, Tavi watched the sunset turn the gentle river into a ribbon of sparkling light.
pages.illustrationScene: Tavi watches a golden sunset turn the gentle river into a ribbon of sparkling light.
pages.continuityNotes: Tavi alone at sunset on the river.

pages.text: Tonight was the Moonlight Lantern Festival, when little boats carried glowing lanterns along the sleepy river.
pages.illustrationScene: Twilight settles for the Moonlight Lantern Festival as glowing lanterns begin to appear on the sleepy river.
pages.continuityNotes: Festival twilight; Tavi alone; background boats may appear muted and secondary.

pages.text: Tavi's best friend, a small lavender boat named Dottie, arrived with a warm smile and a tiny golden lantern.
pages.illustrationScene: Lavender boat Dottie arrives with a warm smile and a tiny golden lantern beside Tavi.
pages.continuityNotes: Introduce Dottie: pastel lavender, ivory cabin, shorter than Tavi, bow eyes, one golden lantern.

pages.text: “Shall we carry the lanterns together?” asked Dottie, for the river looked especially beautiful tonight.
pages.illustrationScene: Dottie asks Tavi if they shall carry the lanterns together on the beautiful evening river.
pages.continuityNotes: Both friends invite a shared lantern float; gentle, no urgency.

pages.text: Tavi happily agreed, and the two friends set their little lanterns glowing beneath the soft evening sky.
pages.illustrationScene: Tavi and Dottie set their little lanterns glowing beneath the soft evening sky.

pages.text: Side by side, Tavi and Dottie drifted slowly downstream together, leaving gentle ripples behind them.
pages.illustrationScene: Side by side, Tavi and Dottie drift slowly downstream together, leaving gentle ripples.

pages.text: They passed sleepy ducks resting among the reeds while fireflies twinkled above the water.
pages.illustrationScene: They pass sleepy ducks among the reeds while fireflies twinkle above the water.
pages.continuityNotes: Sleepy ducks and fireflies; calm water.

pages.text: Beneath an old wooden bridge, the lanterns painted beautiful golden reflections, but the river stayed quiet and calm.
pages.illustrationScene: Under an old wooden bridge, golden lantern reflections shimmer across the quiet river.

pages.text: Soon, other little boats joined the festival, each carrying a lantern that glowed like a tiny floating star.
pages.illustrationScene: Other little boats join the festival, each carrying a lantern like a tiny floating star.
pages.continuityNotes: Background boats secondary with tiny lanterns.

pages.text: Tavi and Dottie watched the lantern lights shimmer beneath the rising moon as the whole river grew peaceful and still.
pages.illustrationScene: Tavi and Dottie watch lantern lights shimmer under the rising moon as the river grows still.

pages.text: “The river looks like a sky full of stars,” whispered Tavi. “I wish this lovely evening could last forever.”
pages.illustrationScene: Tavi whispers that the river looks like a sky full of stars on this lovely evening.

pages.text: “We can remember it in our dreams,” Dottie replied sleepily as they floated toward their cozy little boathouse.
pages.illustrationScene: Dottie replies sleepily as they float toward their cozy little boathouse.
pages.continuityNotes: Float toward cozy boathouse; Dottie sleepy.

pages.text: The two friends settled beside the boathouse, and their golden lanterns dimmed to a soft, sleepy glow.
pages.illustrationScene: Tavi and Dottie settle beside the boathouse while their golden lanterns dim to a soft sleepy glow.
pages.continuityNotes: Settle BESIDE the boathouse, not inside; lanterns dim.

pages.text: Beneath the silver moon and twinkling stars, Tavi and Dottie slept peacefully beside the boathouse, dreaming of glowing lanterns and gentle rivers.
pages.illustrationScene: Tavi and Dottie sleep peacefully beside the boathouse under the silver moon and twinkling stars.
pages.continuityNotes: Both asleep BESIDE the boathouse under moonlight; peaceful ending.
